title: Canadian Bannock Bake
description: A warm and comforting dessert inspired by traditional Canadian cuisine. This gooey bannock bake is perfect for a sweet treat.

ingredients.name: Bannock mix
ingredients.notes: Available at most grocery stores or online

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the bannock mix, brown sugar, and softened butter until well combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, and vanilla extract.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until a dough forms.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead a few times until it comes together.
Roll the dough out into a rectangle about 1/4 inch thick.
Transfer the dough to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Drizzle the honey over the dough, if using.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the bannock is golden brown and set.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
